summary.text: Jeff Eldridge is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 30 and is seeking re-election against Democrat Ryan Elkins in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2004 to 2010 and from 2012 to 2018, and returned to the chamber in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Eldridge earned a B.A. in education and counseling, an M.A. in counseling and a licensed social worker credential from Marshall University.
Eldridge represented West Virginia House of Delegates District 19 from 2004 to 2010 and District 22 from 2012 to 2018, and took office in District 30 in 2024, succeeding David Adkins.
His committee assignments in the 2017 session included Agriculture and Natural Resources, Energy, Government Organization and Senior Citizen Issues.
